name: decision-project
description: Publisher side. Projects one decision to the distributor that owns the quote, by calling the DISTRIBUTOR's own gateway mapping (POST /decision) with the msr- key they minted for us. Callable with {decision_id}. It resolves the distributor and the submission version from the SUBMISSION, not the decision: measured, a BOUND decision written by flow 2 carries neither, so a projection that trusted the decision made every bind outcome undeliverable. It cannot be a record trigger: a record CREATE only republishes when the body sets completed:true, and none of flows 1, 2 or 11 does.

data.name: Project a decision to its distributor
Which submission does it belong to?
Load the submission (by id, so it cannot race the index)
Resolve the distributor and build the projection
